name: Lightbox
summary: The pictures of a set, one at a time and as large as the window allows, over the page: opened from an ImageGrid or a Card, with Previous and Next, a counter and the caption. Built on the same native modal dialog as Dialog.
a11y: A native `dialog` opened with `showModal()`, named by `label`: the page behind is inert and focus stays inside. Focus starts on Close and returns to the picture that opened it. The picture keeps its alternative text; the counter and caption are a polite live region, so moving to another picture announces "3 of 7" and its caption. Previous and Next are named buttons, absent at the ends rather than disabled, so Tab never meets a dead stop. Motion (Q65 C10, K-4): opened from a thumbnail (the focused opener's Image), the picture travels from the thumbnail's place, cropped as it was, to its own while the window fades in around it, and travels back on closing if it is still the picture that was opened; otherwise it fades. Focus returns to the opener when it lands. Reduced motion: no travel, fades only.

keys.action: the previous or next picture (mirrored right to left)

props.name: index
props.description: The picture shown; `null` when closed. The parent owns it.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Previous, Next, the arrow keys or a swipe asked for another picture.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Escape or Close asked to close. Set `index` to `null`.

props.name: label
props.description: What the set is, as the lightbox's name: "Photos from the trip".

props.name: src
props.description: The picture's address (the largest one worth showing).

props.name: width
props.description: The picture's own width and height in pixels, so its frame is right before it loads.
